Design evidence only. Existing requirements, no cosmetic-policy ballot.

Getting to music without a working system source

Purpose: inspect the first-run access and no-audio states under D10/D27. An available system music library opens automatically; when no source is open or device-wide access was declined, the primary route remains Open a folder, with in-app Settings available. True-peak analysis is automatic and not optional (D84), so these states offer no choice about analysis; where a state explains analysis, it only says that it happens.

Every state is authored debug input, not real discovery or permission evaluation. The two no-audio states assume an explicitly complete read of their named scope. A partial, failed or unread source cannot justify those claims. Zero eligible audio in a source does not mean the device or folder has no files.

The native buttons emit debug events only. No picker, Settings, grants, playback, analysis, IME or TalkBack operation was exercised. Existing Android auto-analysis is a separately recorded provisional runtime; these captures do not replace or verify it. No production implementation is authorized.

Inspect the same native conditions

Thumbnails fit the review column. Open any image to inspect it at 100% logical dp or native pixels. These are sanitized app-area crops, not device mockups. Status strips were removed for privacy; bottom navigation remains. Logical dp uses the measured 390dpi density, not your monitor's physical size.

Separate source states

These are state witnesses, not alternatives to select. The complete-empty premises are authored inputs; the existing production list API does not supply equivalent complete/partial/failure status.

Inspect the views kept after dragging the content up

After each first view the content was dragged upward until its pixels stopped changing. Where the content moved, the view at rest is kept here; where nothing moved, no second view exists and none is shown. A kept view needs both changed app pixels and a displaced body text. An unmoved state is not evidence that a gesture was delivered or that the state cannot scroll. These views do not establish TalkBack traversal, recovery actions or scrolling in general.

Read source and implementation boundaries

The host extends ComponentActivity, not MainActivity. The merged debug manifest disables the production launcher, playback and sweep services and removes automatic WorkManager initialization. No real library is loaded.

Fresh fixture tests distinguish complete/zero audio from partial-with-results, partial-without-results, failed and unread input. Unknown scenes and malformed counts are rejected. Separate guard-removal mutants must fail before the fixture is accepted for capture. Those tests do not implement production source-status evaluation.

Current production access gating, lost source outcomes and provisional automatic peak indexing are distinct findings. This review does not pick a recovery owner, widen a chosen folder, adopt template defaults or change Search.

Static fit and source inspection establish neither real picker/Settings completion nor accessibility focus, speech, action-bound or contrast acceptance. All raw status-bearing images, hierarchies and logs remain private. The inspected published app-area crops retain exact RGB, opacity, dimensions and only essential PNG chunks. No digest of an image is recorded, and nothing is compared with a digest (D88).
